name: screen_press
summary: Touch a control on a ScriptedScreens screen as a player's touch does: element_id, or the control at a point; click, change with value, or toggle. The script's handler runs on its next tick. Writes.

help.text: The touch goes into the host's input path, so the handler sees player (default the player's name) as the one who touched it. at [x, y] is surface pixels from the top-left, as screen_read gives boxes: it takes the shown control (button, checkbox, toggle, slider...) with the highest z_index whose box holds the point; scroll positions are not applied. element_id takes any element. Read the screen again after the script's next tick (about 0.5 s) to see the result. Host only.
help.keys: holder {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, surface, element {id, type, box, shown, touch, props}, event, value, player, accepted.

refusals.summary: Why a touch is not sent.
refusals.text: element_not_found; no_control_at (no shown control at the point); surface_not_found; no_screen; screens_mod_required; screens_changed; not_host (a multiplayer client); invalid_argument (an event other than click, change or toggle, change without value, both or neither of element_id and at).

surface.description: The surface; default the one the main screen shows.

element_id.description: The element to touch, as screen_read lists it.

at.description: Or a point [x, y] on the surface, in pixels from the top-left.

value.description: With change: the new value as text (0.5, an option index).

player.description: The name the handler receives; default the player's.
